paragraphs.text: Mr. Orfeo , "the Boulder" is a Rhox warrior in New Capenna .

Mr. Orfeo is towering Rhox of the Riveteers . Clad in reinforced leather and steel, his attire is as imposing as his frame. His weapon of choice, a massive maul, is a testament to his belief that "subtlety is overrated." He was once ambushed by a dozen agents of the Maestros , and it's said the ground still carries their imprints.
